# FOSS Club SRM KTR — Full Knowledge Context

Official Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) Club at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST), Kattankulathur (KTR), Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.
Affiliated with FOSS United Foundation: https://fossunited.org/c/srm-ktr

## Overview
FOSS Club SRM is a student-driven open-source community at SRMIST Kattankulathur. The club empowers students to learn, build, collaborate, and contribute across three main domains:
1. Technical (Web development, Linux kernel internals, Rust, systems programming, open source tooling)
2. Corporate (Event operations, sponsorships, PR, outreach)
3. Creative (UI/UX design, visual branding, multimedia, content creation)

- Recruitments: /recruitments (Domain tracks, eligibility, applications)
